name: emberfall
description: EMBERFALL — deep-range intercept arcade shooter. Zero-build PWA with a self-hosted Node+SQLite command deck: accounts, cloud saves, duels, worldwide boards. 230+ checks fly on every push.

paragraphs: A zero-build arcade space shooter that fits in your browser and never stops proving itself. Everything — art, music, sound — is generated procedurally at runtime: no asset files, no build step, no runtime npm dependencies. Play it offline, host it anywhere, or attach the self-hosted Command Deck for accounts, cloud saves, duels and worldwide boards.

A zero-build, static orbital intercept shooter. Art, music, and sound are generated procedurally at runtime. The game has no runtime package dependencies and plays locally from index.html; hosted installs work offline after their first successful service-worker install.

requirements.text: Play it offline, host it anywhere, or attach the self-hosted Command Deck for accounts, cloud saves, duels and worldwide boards.
The Pages build is the static game only — leaderboards/accounts need the self-hosted node server.js command deck (the game detects this and runs in local mode, saving to the device).

Auth: callsign + password, scrypt-hashed (async, off the event loop), per-user salt, constant-time compare; optional Google sign-in (EFGOOGLECLIENTID) — the deck verifies the ID token itself against Google's JWKS and mints its own session, so a Gmail pilot is the same users row on the same boards (a pre-existing callsign matching the email's local part is adopted, never…
Your device tracks the deck's lifetime payout total for your account and adopts it on sign-in (never the reverse) — so a fresh laptop learns what you were paid without re-banking a single coin.
